task: Connect the visual action-led report and field guide to live v1 audit results.
nonGoals: Backend, rubric or shared contract changes; invented facts or field values; deploying the draft engine; paid usage; merging or unrelated services.

outcomes.description: The existing live submission journey opens an action-first report using only returned product context, fixes, evidence and coverage.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen v1 fixtures and runtime report/adapter tests including partial, zero, failure and cache.

outcomes.description: Charts derive from live check statuses and fixes; unmeasured evidence remains distinct from failure and partial reports have no final score.
outcomes.evidence: Counts, optional metadata, null values, exclusions and conditional-recovery regressions.

outcomes.description: Field-level details map returned affected checks to source findings and bounded verification instructions, without synthetic product leakage or fabricated ready-to-publish copy.
outcomes.evidence: Independent Terra review and source-grounded browser check.

outcomes.description: The public Free Pages preview can submit a real public demo URL and display the updated report.
outcomes.evidence: Manual post-CI deployment and live browser verification.

process.description: Plan before implementation, use Terra agents and independent review, preserve engine ownership and deploy only reviewed frontend assets after hosted CI.
process.evidence: Git chronology, source-bound evaluation and release record.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse the approved report theme and v1 lifecycle without new dependencies or hardcoded fictional findings in live reports.

exitTest.reason: Frontend live-data presentation does not alter agent workflow, portability or resumability.
